summary: ArcBot now offers the current Claude models, picks up new OpenAI and Claude models on its own, and starts new chats on GPT-6.1-Sol at Medium reasoning.
details: Claude choices are Fable 5.1, Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, and Haiku 4.5, read from Anthropic when you are signed in to Claude; Sonnet 5.5 at Medium is the Claude default.
The Model and Reasoning pickers are now app-styled lists with provider groups, a quiet Default tag, a check on the current choice, and keyboard control.
